mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4; albendazole is metabolized by multiple CYP450 pathways), and both can cause hepatotoxicity, increasing risk of additive liver injury.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST/ALT) during concurrent use; consider alternative antifungal if prolonged albendazole therapy is required; advise patient to report signs of hepatotoxicity.
